title: Variational Quantum Simulation of the Interacting Schwinger Model on a Trapped-Ion Quantum Processor
abstract: We explore the multi-flavor lattice Schwinger model in one spatial dimension using variational quantum simulation on a shuttling-based trapped-ion quantum processor. We employ a parametric quantum circuit to identify ground states and map out quantum phase transitions. The fermionic sign problem makes this problem intractable for classical numerical methods even for small system sizes. We use quantum state tomography to analyze correlations in output states and determine the model's phase boundaries across the phase transition.
key_claims: Multi-flavor Schwinger model simulated on shuttling-based trapped-ion processor
Sign problem makes classical simulation intractable even at small sizes -- quantum advantage regime
Variational parametric circuits identify ground states across phase transition
Quantum state tomography extracts correlations and phase boundaries
Demonstrates QFT simulation on trapped-ion beyond single-flavor Schwinger model
